facts.statement: The study used high-resolution imaging methods to compare the structure of inhibitory synapses located on the cell body versus those on the dendrites.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Synapses on the cell body were found to be larger and have a more varied and complex structure than those on the dendrites.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Dendritic synapses typically have a compact shape where receptor clusters are often organized into aligned columns.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Cell body synapses showed a wider variety of structures, including both aligned columns and disorganized arrangements where release sites and receptors did not line up.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Computer simulations suggested that these structural differences lead to stronger electrical signals and different timing properties at cell body synapses.
facts.subject: computational
